_comment: Left = Laserfiche field name on the template (exact). Right = AS400 Bridge capture key; 'a|b' = first non-empty wins. Lists (apSubGlNum) fill multi-value fields or are joined with commas. Dates M/D/YYYY become ISO for Date fields. For dropdown (list) fields the AS400 text is matched to the list values case-insensitively, then by prefix/contains; value_maps gives explicit overrides.
